source_summary: The lean HSConfig runtime lowering surface remains GlobalValues.json, Mulligan.json, per-card CARDID.json, and Combo.json only when exact source-backed sequences exist.
current_truth: HearthRanger VisionAI supports multiple CustomConfig files, but HSConfig normal path should only emit surfaces it can validate and explain from source claims before games are played.
repo_alignment: The compiler modules map source-backed plans into GlobalValues, Mulligan, CardID behavior, and Combo files while README and skill docs keep replay and post-game tuning outside HSConfig.
implementation_implication: source_documents.json may include broader semantics, but unsupported or ambiguous claims should remain in reports until HSConfig has a documented lowering route.
gaps_or_risks: Some CardID behavior blocks are less exercised by fixtures than the common play, target, discover, and attack surfaces.
GlobalValues changes have high blast radius and should stay posture-based, not arbitrary key tuning.
recommended_action: Continue using claim_can_lower_to_runtime and source_claim_gap_report to separate source-builder research work from runtime write eligibility.
uncertain: full coverage of every documented CardID behavior block
